'''Zerba Cher'dak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] pickpocket who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Cher'dak became part of a group of criminals that were gathered together by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Marblewood Estate heist|steal]] the riches of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] official [[Avrak Villachor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]], in a complex heist.
